info.name: FreightFox Dispatch Load Balancer
info.description: Postman Collection for FreightFox Dispatch Load Balancer REST API. Implements order ingestion, vehicle ingestion, and optimized dispatch plan retrieval.

request.description: Retrieves the current dispatch plan. When no orders or vehicles exist, returns HTTP 200 with empty arrays.
Submits two fleet vehicles from the assignment PDF example.
Submits two delivery orders (HIGH and MEDIUM priority) from the assignment PDF example.
Retrieves the optimized plan after submitting Bangalore and Chennai orders and vehicles.
Expects HTTP 400: blank orderId, latitude > 90, blank address, negative packageWeight, invalid priority.

item.name: 6. Validation Error - Duplicate IDs in Batch (Expect HTTP 400)

request.description: Expects HTTP 400: duplicate orderId (ORD_DUP) in the same batch.

item.name: 7. Validation Error - Invalid Vehicle Capacity (Expect HTTP 400)

request.description: Submits the 5 benchmark fleet vehicles from the assignment PDF (total capacity 500 kg).
